hero.headline:
Intelligent Orchestration for
Multi-Cluster Kubernetes
hero.subhead: The open-source event-driven controller that automates add-on distribution, enforces global policies, and eliminates configuration drift across your entire fleet.

oss.heading: Orchestrating deployments across your Kubernetes fleet

features.title: Centralized Distribution
features.desc: Sveltos acts as the control plane for your fleet, orchestrating the distribution of Helm charts, Kustomize overlays, and YAML/JSON manifests from a management cluster to all managed clusters.
features.detail: Manage the entire lifecycle of resources from a single point of truth. Sveltos ensures your core add-ons and applications are consistently deployed, versioned, and kept up-to-date across your entire multi-cluster environment.

features.title: Orchestrated Deployment Order
features.desc: Deploy custom resources in your defined order. Ensure deployments are predictable, controlled, and synchronized across every cluster.
features.detail: Eliminate race conditions by defining precise dependencies. Sveltos ensures stateful components, CRDs, and configurations bootstrap in the exact sequence your application requires.

features.title: Powerful Templating
features.desc: Represent add-ons as templates and let Sveltos automatically inject cluster-specific details for truly dynamic and consistent deployments.
features.detail: Write manifests once and reuse them everywhere. Sveltos dynamically patches templates at runtime using cluster-specific metadata, labels, or real-time data retrieved from the management cluster.

features.title: Event Framework
features.desc: Go beyond static deployments with an event-driven architecture. Monitor managed clusters for specific changes and trigger automatic actions or remediations.
features.detail: Use Lua or CEL to define sophisticated triggers based on resource state. Sveltos can automatically deploy auxiliary tools, rotate certificates, or remediate drift the moment an event is detected.

features.title: Pull Mode
features.desc: Securely manage clusters in restricted environments, including those behind strict firewalls, air-gapped setups, and edge locations.
features.detail: Enable zero-trust management by eliminating inbound connections to your clusters. In Pull Mode, a lightweight agent initiates the connection to retrieve updates, making it perfect for edge computing.

features.title: Drift Detection & Remediation
features.desc: Automatically detect and correct configuration drift. Ensure your clusters always match your desired state, preventing manual 'quick fixes' from causing permanent issues.
features.detail: Sveltos continuously monitors managed clusters. If a resource is modified or deleted locally, Sveltos can notify you or automatically trigger a reconciliation to restore the correct configuration instantly.

enterprise.heading: Scale Your Fleet with Absolute Security and Control

bullets.title: Agent-initiated Pull Mode
bullets.text: Enable zero-trust management where agents connect outbound to the management plane. Securely manage clusters without opening inbound ports or exposing API servers.

bullets.title: Progressive Rollouts & Promotions
bullets.text: Minimize blast radius by staging deployments across environments. Promote changes from Dev to Production only after health checks pass, ensuring fleet-wide stability.

bullets.title: Integrated MCP Server
bullets.text: Empower your AI-driven operations. Sveltos provides a native MCP Server, allowing AI SRE tools to securely discover, query, and manage your entire Kubernetes fleet using natural language.

howItWorks.heading: Unified Orchestration in Six Simple Steps

steps.title: Centralized Control
steps.desc: A single management cluster acts as the 'source of truth,' orchestrating configurations across your entire fleet from a central point.

steps.title: Define Your Intent
steps.desc: Use ClusterProfiles and Profiles to declaratively define add-ons, Helm charts, and policies as standard Kubernetes CRDs.

steps.title: Smart Targeting
steps.desc: Automatically match configurations to clusters using label selectors. Sveltos ensures the right resources reach the right environments instantly.

steps.title: Orchestrate & Sequence
steps.desc: Set deployment phases and resource dependencies to ensure your stack boots in the correct order across every managed cluster.

steps.title: Automated Syncing
steps.desc: Choose your sync mode: OneTime, Continuous, or ContinuousWithDriftDetection to maintain your desired state without manual intervention.

steps.title: Real-Time Distribution
steps.desc: Managed clusters receive updates via push or pull modes, with a lightweight agent ensuring the local state matches your global intent.
